verdict.rationale: Amplitude's docs explicitly claim the ability to 'go from a chart, funnel, or support ticket to the exact session' and to catch errors/rage clicks and replay sessions with full event context, directly matching the PM story of jumping from funnel drop-off or errors to session replay. This is first-party documented functionality but lacks independent/hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: independent user validation of the specific funnel-to-replay jump workflow, and no community evidence confirming reliability of this exact linkage.
